package ssa

import (
	IMPORT_BASE
	"IMPORT_IR"
	"IMPORT_OBJ"
	"IMPORT_SRC"
	"IMPORT_SYS"
	"IMPORT_TYPECHECK"
	"IMPORT_TYPES"
	LOWER_IMPORT
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type snapshotCallsFrontend struct {
	Frontend
	fn   *ir.Func
	link *obj.Link
	wb   bool
}

func (fe *snapshotCallsFrontend) Func() *ir.Func                     { return fe.fn }
func (fe *snapshotCallsFrontend) Syslook(n string) *obj.LSym         { return fe.link.Lookup("runtime." + n) }
func (fe *snapshotCallsFrontend) UseWriteBarrier() bool              { return fe.wb }
func (*snapshotCallsFrontend) Log() bool                             { return false }
func (*snapshotCallsFrontend) Logf(string, ...any)                   {}
func (*snapshotCallsFrontend) Warnl(src.XPos, string, ...any)        {}
func (*snapshotCallsFrontend) Debug_checknil() bool                  { return false }
func (*snapshotCallsFrontend) Fatalf(p src.XPos, s string, a ...any) { panic(fmt.Sprintf(s, a...)) }
func (*snapshotCallsFrontend) SplitSlot(p *LocalSlot, s string, o int64, t *types.Type) LocalSlot {
	return LocalSlot{N: p.N, Type: t, Off: p.Off + o}
}
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	target := struct {
		arch  string
		size  int
		order binary.ByteOrder
	}{os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"), 8, binary.LittleEndian}
	switch target.arch {
	case "386", "mips":
		target.size = 4
	}
	switch target.arch {
	case "mips", "ppc64":
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	}
	SETUP
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOAMD64 = 1
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOARM.Version = 7
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOPPC64 = 8
	LOWER_FEATURES.GORISCV64 = 20
	switch target.arch {
	case "386":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.I386
	case "amd64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.AMD64
	case "arm64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.ARM64
	case "mips":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.MIPS
	case "ppc64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.PPC64
	}
	cfg := UP.NewConfig(target.arch, *UP.NewTypes(), LINK, true, false)
	ty := cfg.Types
	pos := LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("calls.go", "calls.go"), 10, 1))
	var out []string
	add := func(n string, a ...any) { out = append(out, n+":"+fmt.Sprint(a...)) }
	fresh := func(in, outs []*types.Type, stack bool) (*Func, *snapshotCallsFrontend, []*Value, *Value) {
		fields := func(ts []*types.Type, prefix string) []*types.Field {
			var fs []*types.Field
			for i, tp := range ts {
				fs = append(fs, TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup(fmt.Sprint(prefix, i)), tp))
			}
			return fs
		}
		fn := GRAPH.NewFunc(pos, pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("fixture"), TY.NewSignature(nil, fields(in, "a"), fields(outs, "r")))
		fn.DeclareParams(true)
		fe := &snapshotCallsFrontend{fn: fn, link: LINK, wb: true}
		cache := new(Cache)
		cache.Reset()
		f := cfg.NewFunc(fe, cache)
		f.Name = "fixture"
		f.Type = fn.Type()
		f.ABI0 = cfg.ABI0
		f.ABI1 = cfg.ABI1
		f.ABISelf = cfg.ABI1
		if stack {
			f.ABISelf = cfg.ABI0
		}
		f.ABIDefault = f.ABISelf
		f.OwnAux = OwnAuxCall(fn.Linksym(), f.ABISelf.ABIAnalyze(fn.Type(), true))
		f.pass = &pass{name: "calls"}
		b := f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		f.Entry = b
		b.Pos = pos
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		f.spSb()
		var args []*Value
		for _, a := range f.OwnAux.abiInfo.InParams() {
			v := b.NewValue0IA(pos, OpArg, a.Type, a.FrameOffset(f.OwnAux.abiInfo), a.Name)
			args = append(args, v)
		}
		return f, fe, args, mem
	}
	finish := func(n string, f *Func) {
		deadcode(f)
		f.invalidateCFG()
		checkFunc(f)
		add(n, f.String())
		opt(f)
		deadcode(f)
		lower(f)
		lateLower(f)
		deadcode(f)
		f.invalidateCFG()
		checkFunc(f)
		checkLower(f)
		add(n+"/lower", f.String())
	}
	structType := TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("X"), ty.UInt8), TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("Y"), ty.Int64), TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("P"), ty.BytePtr)})
	aggregateTypes := []*types.Type{ty.Int64, ty.String, TY.NewSlice(ty.Int32), TY.Types[types.TINTER], TY.Types[types.TCOMPLEX128], structType, TY.NewArray(ty.Int32, 1), TY.NewArray(ty.Int32, 0)}
	for k, tp := range aggregateTypes {
		for _, stack := range []bool{false, true} {
			f, _, args, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{tp}, []*types.Type{tp}, stack)
			b := f.Entry
			aux := StaticAuxCall(LINK.Lookup("callee"), f.ABIDefault.ABIAnalyzeTypes([]*types.Type{tp}, []*types.Type{tp}))
			call := b.NewValue0A(pos, OpStaticLECall, aux.LateExpansionResultType(), aux)
			call.AddArgs(args...)
			call.AddArg(mem)
			value := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, tp, 0, call)
			mem = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, TY.TypeMem, 1, call)
			ret := b.NewValue2(pos, OpMakeResult, TY.NewResults([]*types.Type{tp, TY.TypeMem}), value, mem)
			b.SetControl(ret)
			checkFunc(f)
			numberLines(f)
			expandCalls(f)
			postExpandCallsDecompose(f)
			finish(fmt.Sprintf("aggregate-%d-stack-%v", k, stack), f)
		}
	}
	// Overflow integer/float register banks, plus all indirect and tail call forms.
	for _, kind := range []Op{OpStaticLECall, OpClosureLECall, OpInterLECall, OpTailLECall, OpTailLECallInter} {
		for _, stack := range []bool{false, true} {
			var ins []*types.Type
			for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
				ins = append(ins, ty.Int64, ty.Float64)
			}
			f, _, args, mem := fresh(ins, nil, stack)
			b := f.Entry
			info := f.ABIDefault.ABIAnalyzeTypes(ins, nil)
			aux := StaticAuxCall(LINK.Lookup("callee"), info)
			if kind == OpClosureLECall {
				aux = ClosureAuxCall(info)
			}
			if kind == OpInterLECall || kind == OpTailLECallInter {
				aux = InterfaceAuxCall(info)
			}
			call := b.NewValue0A(pos, kind, aux.LateExpansionResultType(), aux)
			if kind == OpClosureLECall || kind == OpInterLECall || kind == OpTailLECallInter {
				call.AddArg(b.NewValue1A(pos, OpAddr, ty.BytePtr, LINK.Lookup("code"), func() *Value { _, sb := f.spSb(); return sb }()))
			}
			if kind == OpClosureLECall {
				call.AddArg(b.NewValue0(pos, OpConstNil, ty.BytePtr))
			}
			call.AddArgs(args...)
			call.AddArg(mem)
			mem = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, TY.TypeMem, 0, call)
			b.SetControl(mem)
			if kind == OpTailLECall || kind == OpTailLECallInter {
				b.Kind = BlockRetJmp
				b.Aux = LINK.Lookup("callee")
			}
			checkFunc(f)
			numberLines(f)
			expandCalls(f)
			postExpandCallsDecompose(f)
			finish(fmt.Sprintf("calls-%s-stack-%v", kind, stack), f)
		}
	}
	// Non-SSA-sized call results and arguments must use memory copies.
	for _, stack := range []bool{false, true} {
		wide := TY.NewArray(ty.Int64, 8)
		f, _, args, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{TY.NewPtr(wide), TY.NewPtr(wide)}, nil, stack)
		b := f.Entry
		aux := StaticAuxCall(LINK.Lookup("widecallee"), f.ABIDefault.ABIAnalyzeTypes([]*types.Type{wide}, []*types.Type{wide}))
		value := b.NewValue2(pos, OpDereference, wide, args[0], mem)
		call := b.NewValue2A(pos, OpStaticLECall, aux.LateExpansionResultType(), aux, value, mem)
		value = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, wide, 0, call)
		mem = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, TY.TypeMem, 1, call)
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, wide, args[1], value, mem)
		b.SetControl(mem)
		checkFunc(f)
		numberLines(f)
		expandCalls(f)
		postExpandCallsDecompose(f)
		finish(fmt.Sprint("wide-stack-", stack), f)
	}
	// Barrier expansion must retain the memory order and volatile move copies.
	for _, stack := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, cgo := range []bool{false, true} {
			for _, kind := range []string{"stores", "zero", "move", "volatile", "stack", "disabled"} {
				EXPERIMENT.CgoCheck2 = cgo
				f, fe, args, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{TY.NewPtr(ty.BytePtr), ty.BytePtr, TY.NewPtr(ty.BytePtr)}, nil, stack)
				b := f.Entry
				ptr, val, source := args[0], args[1], args[2]
				sp, _ := f.spSb()
				if kind == "stack" {
					ptr = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, TY.NewPtr(ty.BytePtr), 128, sp)
				}
				if kind == "disabled" {
					fe.wb = false
				}
				if kind == "volatile" {
					source = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, TY.NewPtr(ty.BytePtr), 64, sp)
				}
				switch kind {
				case "zero":
					mem = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpZero, TY.TypeMem, ty.BytePtr.Size(), ptr)
					mem.Aux = ty.BytePtr
					mem.AddArg(b.Values[0])
				case "move", "volatile":
					mem = b.NewValue3I(pos, OpMove, TY.TypeMem, ty.BytePtr.Size(), ptr, source, mem)
					mem.Aux = ty.BytePtr
				default:
					for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
						dst := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, ptr.Type, int64(i)*ty.BytePtr.Size(), ptr)
						mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.BytePtr, dst, val, mem)
					}
				}
				b.SetControl(mem)
				checkFunc(f)
				numberLines(f)
				writebarrier(f)
				add("wbmeta", fe.fn.WBPos.IsKnown(), len(fe.fn.Dcl))
				finish(fmt.Sprintf("wb-%s-stack-%v-cgo-%v", kind, stack, cgo), f)
			}
		}
	}
	EXPERIMENT.CgoCheck2 = false
	// Pure loops need a memory chain introduced; effectful loops need phi repair.
	for _, noSplit := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, effect := range []bool{false, true} {
			f, _, args, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{ty.Int32, TY.NewPtr(ty.Int32)}, nil, false)
			f.NoSplit = noSplit
			e := f.Entry
			h, body, exit := f.NewBlock(BlockIf), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
			for _, b := range []*Block{h, body, exit} {
				b.Pos = pos
			}
			e.Kind = BlockPlain
			e.AddEdgeTo(h)
			h.AddEdgeTo(body)
			h.AddEdgeTo(exit)
			body.AddEdgeTo(h)
			i := h.NewValue1(pos, OpPhi, ty.Int32, f.ConstInt32(ty.Int32, 0))
			next := body.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd32, ty.Int32, i, f.ConstInt32(ty.Int32, 1))
			i.AddArg(next)
			h.SetControl(h.NewValue2(pos, OpLess32, ty.Bool, i, args[0]))
			if effect {
				m := h.NewValue1(pos, OpPhi, TY.TypeMem, mem)
				m.AddArg(body.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.Int32, args[1], i, m))
				mem = m
			}
			exit.SetControl(mem)
			checkFunc(f)
			numberLines(f)
			insertLoopReschedChecks(f)
			finish(fmt.Sprintf("loop-nosplit-%v-effect-%v", noSplit, effect), f)
		}
	}
	{
		f, _, _, _ := fresh(nil, nil, false)
		e := f.Entry
		e.Kind = BlockPlain
		h := f.NewBlock(BlockPlain)
		h.Pos = pos
		e.AddEdgeTo(h)
		h.AddEdgeTo(h)
		numberLines(f)
		deadcode(f)
		insertLoopReschedChecks(f)
		finish("loop-without-memory", f)
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("SYNCGO_IR=%s\n", data)
}
